settings.question: Can I bring my own radio?
settings.answer: Yes. Fitting is €150 when you supply the radio, fascia kit and harness.

settings.question: Will my steering wheel controls work?
settings.answer: Usually, if your radio and harness support them. Send us the radio details and your reg and we will check first.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: About an hour and a half for most cars.

settings.heading: Android radio questions
settings.text: What drivers ask us before booking.

settings.title: Fitted properly, first time
settings.content: An Android radio is only as good as the fitting. We check the fascia and harness suit your car, route the wiring out of sight, set up the controls and test everything with your phone before you leave.

settings.heading: Visit the workshop
settings.text: Drop in to see screens and speakers working, or bring your car for a fitting.
